errors.evidence: The description of the y-axis tick labels incorrectly lists '0' and omits the tick label at '45'.

The description incorrectly states that the 'Base' line starts at a co-occurrence number of 1. The first data point is located between 1 (10^0) and 10 (10^1). This error is repeated for all six lines.
The description states that the 'Base' line ends at approximately 42%, but the chart shows its final value is approximately 44%.
The description states the 'MEND' line ends at approximately 56%, but the chart shows it ends closer to 56.5%.
The description incorrectly identifies the marker for the 'FT' line as a triangle. The legend and plot show it uses inverted triangle markers.
The description states that the 'FT' line ends at approximately 44%, but its final value on the chart is approximately 47.5%.
The description incorrectly states that the 'MEMIT' line uses square markers. The legend shows it uses pentagon markers; square markers are used for the 'ROME' line.
The description states the 'MEMIT' line starts at approximately 51%, which is the starting value for the 'ROME' line. The 'MEMIT' line actually starts at approximately 43.5%.
The description states the 'MEMIT' line ends at approximately 53%. The chart shows its final value is closer to 54.5%.
The description states that the 'ROME' line ends at approximately 62%, but its final value on the chart is visibly above 65%, at approximately 66%.
The description states that the 'IKE' line ends at approximately 53.5%. The chart shows its final value is approximately 49.5%.
